correctness.rationale: A graph Morse simplex is an acyclic partial orientation with outdegree at most one. Exhaustive enumeration of all \(3^{12}\) cube-edge states reproduces the face vector \((24,240,1296,4080,7488,7424,3072)\), independently matching \(t(t+2)^3(t+4)^3(t+6)\). Exact mod-2 boundary elimination gives ranks \((1,23,217,1079,3001,4487,2933)\), hence Betti ranks \(4\) and \(139\) in degrees \(5,6\). The verifier also checks all faces and \(\partial^2=0\).
